vienna-eastern-alps-hohe-wand-and-puchbe.slogan: A 633 km loop out of Hohe Wand and Puchberg
vienna-eastern-alps-hohe-wand-and-puchbe.story: A proper escape from Vienna with roads worth waking up for. A 633 km loop that starts and ends near Drassburg, about 11 h 31 of riding. The stops in between: Scenic stretch in Prinzersdorf, near Japons and near Brezová pod Bradlom. The climb of the day is near Otterthal. It tops out at about 850 m. It crosses from Austria into Slovakia - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Lake Garda Western Shore and Strada della Forra
